title: Cheesy Lasagna
description: A classic Italian dish with layers of pasta, cheese, and rich flavors. This recipe makes a satisfying meal for a family dinner.
instructions: Cook the lasagna sheets according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the tomato sauce and stir to combine.
Bring the sauce to a simmer and let cook for 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine the Croatian cheese and molten cheese.
Add the cooked lasagna sheets to the bowl and toss to combine with the cheese mixture.
Spread a layer of tomato sauce in the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Arrange 4 lasagna sheets on top of the sauce.
Sprinkle with half of the cheese mixture and half of the xtra mozzarella cheese.
Repeat the layers, starting with the lasagna sheets, then the tomato sauce, and finally the remaining cheese mixture and mozzarella cheese.
Top the lasagna with the chopped fresh basil, if using.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
